Made for your own day.

Your records stay on your computer. A convenience tool for your day, independent of the company’s official attendance system.

A LITTLE LESS TO REMEMBER

Small details.
A smoother workday.

Keep the information you check often in one easy place.

01

Your day, within reach

View your arrival, scheduled departure and remaining time from the menu bar or tray.

02

Your routine, remembered

Set work and break hours. Morning and afternoon half days and the last-Friday rule are included.

03

A display that suits you

Choose Korean or English and switch between five time formats, including decimal hours.

04

Personal records, kept local

Review recent attendance and make a manual correction. Attendance features work without an account.

Mac and Windows 1.5.12 detect automatic arrivals from 06:00 and record observations before 08:00 at 08:00. Manual entries and morning-off rules are unchanged.

Mac 1.5.12 includes an arrival calendar and events from the two selected calendars. Browse dates and sync status in Settings. Server round-trip sync remains a beta feature. Check supported versions and features ↗

GET STARTED IN THREE STEPS

Download. Open. Make it yours.

01

Give it a home

On Mac, open the DMG and move HappyLulu to Applications. On Windows, install .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64 and extract the entire ZIP to a permanent folder.

02

Click the smiling clock

Find HappyLulu in the menu bar or system tray. Already at work? Enter your arrival and workday mode manually.

03

Choose your routine

Set work and break hours, language and display format. Mac startup may need system approval; Windows startup is enabled in settings.

Quit the old app before replacing it. Keep your records when updating. Read the full guide ↗
